Definition: Infant born with signs of life
Fetal death before/at delivery according to applicable reporting definition
Pregnancy loss before the locally applicable gestational threshold
Birth size below the selected gestational-age reference threshold
Birth size above the selected gestational-age reference threshold
Clinically significant postpartum bleeding; threshold depends on delivery context/definition
GDM affecting pregnancy and/or delivery management
Blood component transfusion during pregnancy/delivery/postpartum episode
Higher-level maternal care during delivery episode
Documented congenital anomaly identified at/around delivery
